executiveSummary: U.S. multi-agency advisory warns of active, AI-assisted targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs (TCP/102 S7comm) with risk of unsafe process changes and loss of control. Security Advisory Iranian-affiliated actors continue exploiting internet-exposed PLCs across Water/Wastewater, Energy, and municipal facilities to alter logic, suppress alarms, and cause downtime. Security Advisory Critical Cisco ISE flaw (CVSS 10) is being exploited to gain root via API abuse, risking collapse of IT/OT segmentation and policy enforcement. Immediate patching and access restrictions are required. View Article MikroTik RouterOS pre-auth/priv-esc chains are under active exploitation, enabling SSH takeover of edge routers commonly bridging to OT networks; patch and audit now. Supporting Report Hitachi Energy FACTS Control Platform (grid stabilization) has multiple 9.9-CVSS flaws in GWS that could allow remote manipulation; isolate, patch, and harden access paths. Security Advisory Danfoss iC7 variable-frequency drives expose debug/update paths permitting unsigned code uploads and parameter tampering; strict zoning and firmware controls advised. CISA Bulletin CISA weekly bulletins include high-impact OT/adjacent issues (EV charging OCPP control, telecom NMS accounts, AWS SSM Agent SSRF, PcVue credential weaknesses); prioritize remediation by exposure. CISA Bulletin Active Zimbra webmail exploitation (LAUNDRY BEAR) exfiltrates 90 days of email and MFA artifacts via a view-only XSS chain; rotate credentials/tokens and patch immediately. Security Advisory China-nexus actors are building covert SOHO/IoT proxy networks to pre-position in Critical Infrastructure; purge EoL routers/IoT, enforce segmentation and egress controls. Security Advisory

Russian state-supported activity (FSB Center 16) abusing SNMP/TFTP and legacy features to compromise routers and exfiltrate configs. Security Advisory

relevance: Risk is concentrated at the control boundary and PLC layers. Multiple advisories confirm active exploitation paths into PLCs (Siemens S7) and ongoing intrusions by state-supported and hacktivist groups targeting ICS HMIs and controllers. Concurrent exploitation of network access control (Cisco ISE) and edge routing (MikroTik) increases the likelihood of IT-to-OT pivots even where controllers are not internet-exposed. Grid stabilization platforms (Hitachi Energy FCP) and industrial drives (Danfoss iC7) carry manipulation risk if interfaces are reachable or trust is weak. Immediate segmentation, exposure reduction, and patching are essential to reduce operational impact likelihood.

items: Cisco ISE: CVE-2026-76460 (active exploitation). View Article
MikroTik RouterOS: multiple CVEs incl. SSH auth bypass/DoS/priv-esc; active exploitation. Supporting Report
Hitachi Energy FCP (GWS): CVEs including missing auth/anti-replay/path traversal (CVSS up to 9.9). Security Advisory
Danfoss iC7 drive families: debug/update abuse, unsigned code/param manipulation. CISA Bulletin
EV charging/OCPP, CIENA telecom NMS, AWS SSM Agent SSRF, PcVue credential handling, and GeoVision ONVIF: high-impact OT-adjacent issues. CISA Bulletin
NetScaler ADC/Gateway SAML RCE (CVE-2026-8452) with public PoC; patch and hunt for web shells. JPCERT Advisory

descriptions: Direct PLC access via S7comm (T0865/T0883) and unsafe internet exposure
Valid accounts and Living-off-the-Land across IT/OT boundaries (T1078, T1218, T1059)
Edge device abuse: SNMP/TFTP config exfil (T1041), router auth bypass
Web exploitation: XSS to mailbox takeover (Zimbra), SAML/ACS abuse (NetScaler)
VNC brute-force/default creds on OT HMIs (T1110.003)
API and NAC bypass to root (Cisco ISE) undermining segmentation

outlook72h: Complete emergency exposure review: confirm no PLCs/HMIs are directly internet-reachable; close discovered exposures within 24 hours. Deploy urgent updates and config changes on Cisco ISE and MikroTik routers; restrict management planes to VPN/JIT-approved sources. Enforce S7comm DPI allowlists and block unauthorized WRITE/PUT in industrial firewalls for Siemens environments. Implement SIEM hunts: Zimbra exfil (DNS/HTTPS tunneling), ISE API anomalies, MikroTik new users/SSH strings, and NetScaler SAML ACS webshells. Isolate Hitachi Energy FCP interfaces; verify mutual TLS and freshness (nonces/timestamps); schedule vendor patch windows. Brief operations leadership on elevated CRITICAL posture; prepare incident containment steps for PLC tampering and NAC compromise scenarios.
